`python3 roster.py inactive` now lists every learner whose last login was 14 or more days ago. I ran it against the current `learners.json` and it returns two learners:

```
L-004  Dara Novak           dara@example.org         2026-08-11  53 days
L-002  Ben Whitlock         ben.w@example.org        2026-09-02  31 days
```

Each row shows id, name, email, last login date and days since. Rows are sorted longest-inactive first, unlike the name order used by `list`, so the most at-risk learners are at the top.

The threshold is the `INACTIVE_AFTER_DAYS` constant near the top of `roster.py`. I also added the command to the usage text and the README.
